title: The Fall of Israel

questions.question: Who was the last king of Israel?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 17:1 (ESV): "...Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel..."

questions.question: Who besieged Samaria and carried Israel away captive?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 17:5-6 (ESV): "Then the king of Assyria invaded all the land... In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria, and he carried the Israelites away to Assyria..."

questions.question: Why was Israel conquered and exiled?
options: Because they sinned against the LORD their God
questions.correctAnswer: Because they sinned against the LORD their God
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 17:7 (ESV): "And this occurred because the people of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God..."

questions.question: What did the people of Israel worship instead of God?
options: Idols, Baal, and the host of heaven
questions.correctAnswer: Idols, Baal, and the host of heaven
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 17:16 (ESV): "...and made an Asherah and worshiped all the host of heaven and served Baal."

questions.question: Who did the king of Assyria settle in the cities of Samaria?
options: People from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim
questions.correctAnswer: People from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 17:24 (ESV): "And the king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim..."

questions.question: What happened to the new settlers at first?
options: Lions killed some of them because they did not fear the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Lions killed some of them because they did not fear the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 17:25 (ESV): "...they did not fear the LORD, and the LORD sent lions among them, which killed some of them."

questions.question: Who was sent back to teach the new settlers how to fear the Lord?
options: One of the priests who had been carried away
questions.correctAnswer: One of the priests who had been carried away
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 17:27-28 (ESV): "...Send there one of the priests... So one of the priests... came and lived in Bethel and taught them how they should fear the LORD."

questions.question: Did the new settlers stop worshiping their own gods?
options: No, they feared the LORD but also served their own gods
questions.correctAnswer: No, they feared the LORD but also served their own gods
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 17:33 (ESV): "So they feared the LORD but also served their own gods..."

questions.question: Where were the Israelites placed in Assyria?
options: In Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes
questions.correctAnswer: In Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 17:6 (ESV): "...and placed them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes."

questions.question: What evil did they do regarding their children?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 17:17 (ESV): "And they burned their sons and their daughters as offerings..."

questions.question: Who had Hoshea sought alliance with against Assyria?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 17:4 (ESV): "...because he had sent messengers to So, king of Egypt..."

questions.question: Which tribe was left to the house of David?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 17:18 (ESV): "...none was left but the tribe of Judah only."

questions.question: What specific gods did the men of Babylon make?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 17:30 (ESV): "The men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth..."

questions.question: What gods did the Sepharvites burn their children to?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 17:31 (ESV): "...the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech..."

key_verse_text: Until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he had spoken by all his servants the prophets. So Israel was exiled from their own land to Assyria until this day. (ESV)
